work.title: Cantate ved Kong Frederik den Syvendes Bisættelse i Roeskilde Domkirke den 19de December 1863
Cantata for the Interment of King Frederik VII in Roskilde Cathedral on 19 December 1863
O Sorgens Syn!

event.desc: Concert for the benefit of the inhabitants of Sønderborg, where 80% of the houses had been destroyed during the Prussian bombardment on 2 & 3 April.

history.p: King Frederik VII died on 15 November 1863, but was not interred in Roskilde Cathedral until 19 December. On 25 November Hartmann still had not received the text, but he managed to end-date the manuscript 13 December. According to Hartmann the cantata produced an impression which never before had been achieved through song in Roskilde Catherdal.

termList.term: Music for vocal soloists and instruments with or without choir

incipText.p: Ja, aand kun tungt, o Danmark!
Herlige Tid, da Brystet kun rummed hvad der var kjærligt og godt!
Saa sving i Seiersklædebon til Himlen dig
